description: B-64: the quoted 2028-2031 cells rerun with link windows that run on into 2032-2050 (a cached joined file: earth_link-v1 then earth_link-v3; not committed), paired with the committed rows (same cell, seed and start year: same CRN). Differences are joined - committed. Re-draws = blackout_jobs_refused per run. 'moves_more_than_last_printed_digit': |change of the cell mean| > the precision printed (tonnage 0.1 t overall and 1 t by start year, completion 1 %, censored p90 1 h, re-draws 1 per run). Robustness only: no row is replaced.

paper_values.method: paper/r1/build_r1.values() on two copies of the E21 results with every derived table and CSV-derived fit block regenerated (write_tables; analyse_e21 fit --round r2, bounded, rescue, rescue --scope any, helper, years): 'base' = rows as committed, 'joined' = the six quoted cells' rows from the joined runs. Simulation-only blocks (bounded.pool_starvation, helper.diagnosis_168h) carried over.

verdict_cells_assumed_precision: 8 cell means move by more than their last printed digit (see the list)
cell_means_beyond_assumed_precision: H dedicated k=1 24 h delivered_t_in_year overall: 523.4 -> 523.7
H dedicated k=1 24 h delay_prio1_p90_censored_h overall: 1353 -> 1354
verdict: yes: 18 of the paper's 404 quoted values change in their printed digits (paper_values.moved); every change comes from the 2031 start-year rows
verdict_paper: yes: 18 of the paper's 404 quoted values change in their printed digits (paper_values.moved); every change comes from the 2031 start-year rows
not_rerun: Only the six quoted cells were rerun. Their 2031 rows carry the edge, and so do the 2031 rows of every other 2028-2031 cell (Stages A2, B, C, D, E, F, G, the other H cells); quoted values built from those cells' own rows are not covered here, only those built against the six.
